object: PROGRAM-LOCAL CLOSED AUDIT LIST OF POLYNOMIAL EXACT CARRIER ESCAPE MECHANISMS REQUIRED BEFORE ANY LATER CONNECTED-CORE STRESS FAMILY MAY BE PROMOTED AS UNCOVERED

interpretation.closed_for_program: This is not a claim to enumerate every polynomial graph algorithm in mathematics. It freezes the mechanisms that this research lineage must explicitly check before declaring a new stress family uncovered.
interpretation.promotion_rule: A later candidate may be labeled UNCOVERED only after every listed mechanism is either applied successfully or rejected by an exact failed precondition with source-bound evidence.

mandatory_carrier_classes.mechanism: Common globally absent color / exact reduction to P7-free List-3
mandatory_carrier_classes.authority: sealed B2B2-E K_k negative control plus constructive P7-free List-3 backend
mandatory_carrier_classes.test: After exact fixed-color propagation and canonical return, does every active nonfixed vertex lie in a common palette of size at most three?
Does the future-complete dependency hypergraph split into independent Q_ALL blocks with polynomial local carriers?

mandatory_carrier_classes.authority: sealed component message, Q_ALL, selector and component-transition theorems
mandatory_carrier_classes.test: Can the apparent complexity be compiled into finite component messages/selectors/transition signatures, leaving a smaller live dynamic core?

mandatory_carrier_classes.mechanism: Exact interface quotient / factorized-feedback / two-relation boundary / guarded bounded-output / singleton or pair separator carriers
mandatory_carrier_classes.authority: sealed TRUMP exact-interface and factorization portfolio artifacts
mandatory_carrier_classes.test: Does the candidate satisfy the exact frozen preconditions of any existing interface/separator carrier? No heuristic resemblance is sufficient.

mandatory_carrier_classes.mechanism: Bounded-total-color List Coloring on permutation graphs
mandatory_carrier_classes.authority: Enright-Stewart-Tardos 2014 source audit; E1 X_k seal
mandatory_carrier_classes.test: Is every active graph an induced subgraph of a chain/permutation graph (or another source-certified permutation representation) with a bounded total palette?

mandatory_carrier_classes.mechanism: Fixed-k List Coloring on bounded mim-width/sim-width when a valid polynomially obtainable decomposition is supplied by source structure
mandatory_carrier_classes.authority: published bounded-width List Coloring machinery already present in the research source inventory
mandatory_carrier_classes.test: Is there a source-derived decomposition with a proven constant bound and polynomial construction? Global recognition/optimization of mim-width or sim-width is forbidden.

mandatory_carrier_classes.mechanism: Lozin-Zamaraev chain decomposition / bounded mim-width route for P7-free bipartite residual cores
mandatory_carrier_classes.authority: published source inventory already sealed as reusable only under exact bipartite P7-free preconditions
mandatory_carrier_classes.test: Is the unresolved connected live core bipartite P7-free in the exact source sense, with the published decomposition constructible?

mandatory_carrier_classes.mechanism: Secondary exact decomposition inside an apparently connected Q_ALL block
mandatory_carrier_classes.authority: B2B2-C allows only exact dependency support; ordinary graph connectedness does not forbid a finer exact algebraic/interface factorization
mandatory_carrier_classes.test: Can the future R1/R2/source/reconstruction contract be decomposed by a sealed exact carrier even though Q_ALL is connected?

mandatory_source_audit_rule.before_new_carrier: Search current repo authority and public literature for a source-applicable carrier matching the candidate's exact graph/list/interface class.
mandatory_source_audit_rule.new_public_carrier: If a newly found published mechanism applies, add it to the E2 inventory by a binding addendum before E3 promotion.
mandatory_source_audit_rule.no_open_ended_claim: Failure to find a carrier after the declared audit is OPEN_NO_KNOWN_CARRIER, not a theorem that none exists.

required_receipt_per_candidate: candidate identifier and frozen source construction
for every FAIL_TO_APPLY: exact missing precondition
for every PASS_APPLIES: explicit carrier and polynomial lifecycle
whether secondary factorization closes the candidate
firewalls: Failure of all E2 carriers is not a lower bound against other algorithms.
No raw state/profile count is a hardness proxy.
No four-color activity is a hardness proxy.
No new carrier may be invented before reuse/source audit completes.
